name: step
source: optimizer steps completed before this one

name: stage
source: data_stages entry active at this step

name: loss
source: total = loss_ntp + z_loss, mean over the global batch

name: loss_ntp
source: next-token cross-entropy, mean over the global batch (losses.tsv)

name: loss_mtp
source: reserved, MTP off in v0 (head.mtp_heads 0): always null

name: z_loss
source: z_loss_coef * mean(logsumexp(logits)^2)

name: grad_norm
source: global grad norm before clipping (all shards and stages)

name: lr
source: WSD schedule optim.lr_at, applied to all param groups

name: tokens_per_second
source: global_batch_seqs*seq_len / step wall time

name: step_time_ms
source: wall time of the step on rank 0 (incl. comm, excl. eval/checkpoint)

name: gpu_alloc_gb
source: torch.cuda.memory_allocated()/1e9 on rank 0; 0 on CPU

name: spike_score
source: (loss - mean)/std over the last safety.spike_window losses; null < 10

name: ema_z
source: (loss - EMA)/sqrt(EMA var), alpha safety.ema_alpha; null at step 0

name: update_to_weight_ratio
source: ||w_after - w_before|| / ||w_before||, all params

name: max_attn_logit
source: max |q.k|/sqrt(hd) over layers, last micro-batch

name: held_out_loss
source: CE on data.val_batch() after the step

name: bpb
source: held_out_loss / ln2 / val bytes per token (manifest)

name: dead_experts
source: experts with 0 routed tokens this step, summed over MoE layers

name: top_expert_share
source: max over MoE layers of the busiest expert's token share

name: moe_aux
source: seq-wise aux loss (coef applied), last micro-batch, summed over layers; in the gradient, not in `loss`
